theorems.name: Submission.dpfir_imrep_pairing_continuous_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous β → HasCompactSupport β → tsupport β ⊆ U → Integrable (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (β x)) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier)
